query: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT client_id), COUNT(DISTINCT account_id) FROM disp; SELECT COUNT(*) FROM (SELECT account_id FROM disp GROUP BY account_id HAVING COUNT(*) > 1); SELECT COUNT(*) FROM (SELECT client_id FROM disp GROUP BY client_id HAVING COUNT(*) > 1)
result: 5369 distinct clients, 4500 distinct accounts, 869 accounts carry more than one disposition row and 0 clients do. The 869 multi-row accounts equal the 869 disponent grants exactly, so each such account has one owner and one disponent.
validation_method: distinct counts and grouped having counts

query: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM loan; SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT account_id) FROM loan; SELECT COUNT(*) FROM (SELECT account_id FROM loan GROUP BY account_id HAVING COUNT(*) > 1)
result: 682 loan rows, 682 distinct account identifiers, 0 accounts with more than one loan. The loan to account relationship is one-to-one in this data.
validation_method: distinct count against row count

query: SELECT COUNT(*), SUM(CASE WHEN c.district_id = a.district_id THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) FROM client c JOIN disp d USING(client_id) JOIN account a USING(account_id)
result: 5369 links, of which 4875 have equal client and account districts and 494 differ. The two district roles are therefore genuinely independent and cannot be substituted for one another.
validation_method: agreement census across every client-account link

validation_method: distinct count and overlap count against the account entity
